verdict.rationale: A public scraper marketplace with revenue sharing is a fair axis for a web-scraping platform, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents publishing scrapers to a marketplace or earning revenue. The pack covers only ScrapingBee's own scraping APIs, CLI, scheduling and MCP server, which are consumer-side features, not a developer marketplace.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish my custom scraper to a public marketplace and earn revenue when others use it
